name: std::extents<IndexType,Extents...>::dynamic-index-inv

declarations.code:
private:
static constexpr auto /*dynamic-index-inv*/ (rank_type i) noexcept;

intro: Returns the number r such that in range [0, r + 1) there are exactly [0, i + 1) dynamic extents. If i <= rank_dynamic() is false, the behavior is undefined.

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: The minimum value of r such that dynamic-index(r + 1) == i + 1 is true.
